claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately reproduces the stated purpose of the subchapter from 8 FAM 801.2-1(a).
The claim accurately reflects the definition and characteristics of IRLs as stated in 8 FAM 801.2-1(b).
The claim accurately captures the mandatory duty to fully adjudicate an application prior to suspending.
The claim accurately captures the statement regarding the careful crafting and objective of IRLs.
The claim accurately sets forth the prohibition on unilateral changes to IRLs by passport agencies/centers, along with the specific exception and illustrative example.
The claim accurately reflects the requirement for posts to use cleared language in IRLs.
The claim accurately captures the authority granted to posts to modify IRL language to suit local logistical requirements and concerns.
The claim accurately states that IRLs are not adjudicative guidance.
The claim accurately preserves the requirement that applications be adjudicated per 8 FAM before selecting the appropriate IRL to address passport or CRBA deficiencies.
The claim accurately reflects the definition and function of INs as standardized notices providing passport bearers with information.
The claim accurately states the illustrative purposes for which an IN may be included.
The claim accurately captures the statement regarding the careful crafting and objective of INs.
The claim accurately sets forth the prohibition against unilateral changes to INs at passport agencies/centers, including the exception and endorsement 46 example.
The claim accurately captures the rule that INs do not require an applicant response.
The claim accurately captures the exemption that INs do not need to be personalized with the applicant's name and address.
The claim accurately captures the permission for posts to consult indexes or contact AskPPTAdjudication@state.gov when tailoring correspondence.
